description: This Java class 'RenameComponents' reads a file specifying component renaming rules and applies these replacements to all files within a specified source directory, writing the modified files to a destination directory.

classes.name: RenameComponents
classes.description: A utility class that performs renaming of code components by reading rules from a file and applying them to target source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program; orchestrates reading the renaming rules and processing source files.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads a source file, applies renaming rules to each line, and writes the output to a destination file.

methods.name: processLine
methods.description: Applies all renaming rules to a single line of source code.

methods.name: processLine (overloaded)
methods.description: Replaces specific string patterns within a line.

methods.name: readReplaceRequest
methods.description: Reads the renaming rules from the specified file into a map.

methods.name: assertFolder
methods.description: Checks that a directory exists; throws an exception if not.
